say:4:1622324002:0.text: Wait... this is... a crab?! Where's my starglider?! It's a fish! Did this thing eat it?!

choice_prompt:6:1622324002.text: Wait... this is... a crab?! Where's my starglider?! It's a fish! Did this thing eat it?!

say:7:1622324003:0.text: So that's it... I knew it! The author of Essentials of Ancient Alchemy didn't publish the full truth.

say:8:1622324004:0.text: He probably only tested with a single drop, which explains why he only noted the basic phenomenon—scales that glow like starlight.
say:8:1622324004:0.source_cn: 他肯定只敢用一滴来做实验，所以只观察到了鳞片像星光一样...

say:9:1622324005:0.text: He never had the nerve to try using a full bottle!
say:9:1622324005:0.source_cn: 他绝对没有胆量用一整瓶！

say:10:1622324006:0.text: Which means he completely missed what happens under full exposure. When pushed to the limit by Startear Essence, aquatic creatures undergo violent mutations as their bodies scramble to find a new magical equilibrium!
say:10:1622324006:0.source_cn: 所以他根本不知道，在星泪精华的极限催化下，水生生物为了...

say:11:1622324007:0.text: This is a perfect case study—a miraculous intersection of alchemy and transformative biology!
say:11:1622324007:0.source_cn: 这……这简直是炼金术与生物变形学的交叉奇迹！

say:12:1622324008:0.text: A working title could be On the Evolutionary Leap of Fish Under High-Dose Startear Influence.
say:12:1622324008:0.source_cn: 论星泪精华对鱼类生命形态迁跃的革命性影响！
